rules: Every `new` exists in tokens/tokens.css (checked by scripts/build_map.py); newValue is resolved through var() chains.
Default target = the official v3 migration (tokens/migration-2026.11.21.csv) for semantic, component and effect tokens.
Colour primitives follow the owner rule (legacy blue -> green at the same step) plus the v3 re-binding of v2 green steps (rebrand/tokens/v3-map.json); the CSV maps them by name, one tier off.
Text styles keep their legacy weight (legacy-weight twins); per-property variables map to the tokens their .ps-text-* class uses.
Where the v3 value departs from the owner rule of 2026-11-20 (look parity), `alternative` names an existing token that keeps the old step; see unresolved.md.
